text:
maria_cs: Heads up — Avira Labs onboarding showing a spend spike, ~3x expected token burn over last 48h. Seeing heavy embedding calls from their search index job. We should lock in a short-term safety net and a follow-up QBR prep.
leo_finops: :eyes: do we have a per-route breakdown? rough run rate and projected 7d burn if spike continues?
sam_se: Quick snapshot from the console earlier: route `/v1/embeddings` accounts for ~78% of tokens. Current burn rate projects ~1.8M tokens/day if unchanged.
maria_cs: can we set an immediate budget alert and a soft throttle policy? want to avoid renewal flags. Also plan a 30-min enablement with their infra lead tomorrow.
leo_finops: I'll create a temporary credit cushion — suggest 20% buffer and a budget alert at 70%/90% of cushion. Also recommend configuring a route-level cap for `/v1/embeddings`.
anya_enablement: I can run the enablement session. agenda: 1) why embedding patterns spike, 2) batching/caching options, 3) token quotas & fallback models. When works for Avira?
sam_se: They said AM PT preferred. I'll DM them. For quick mitigation, we can flip their embeddings to cached-index snapshot while they investigate.
leo_finops: Making the alert now. runbook-bot: Created alert "avira-onboard-burn-70-90" (ID: RB-8742). Triggers: usage >= 70% of cushion and escalation at 90%.
runbook-bot: Suggested play: 
```
# Temporary safety net play
1) add 20% credit buffer to account
2) set route caps: /v1/embeddings -> 800k tokens/day
3) enable prefix caching for embeddings job
4) schedule enablement + 24h follow-up
```
maria_cs: Nice. Can you also capture a short note for the QBR packet: root cause hypothesis + mitigation + next steps? We need one slide.
sam_se: Draft for QBR slide: "Onboarding indexing job produced unexpectedly dense queries hitting embedding route; mitigation: cached snapshot + route cap + enablement training; outcome: projected burn reduced to ~0.6M tokens/day post-mitigation."
leo_finops: I'll add cost delta numbers and the buffer math to the slide.
anya_enablement: I'll lead the enablement and record the session. Will include a small playbook: batching example and caching TTLs.
maria_cs: Assigning action owners: leo_finops -> create cushion + alerts (done), sam_se -> implement route cap + cache (in progress), anya_enablement -> enablement session (scheduled). I'll update renewal-risk tracker after 24h.
sam_se: Implemented cap and enabled cache snapshot; monitoring for regression. (reacted :thumbsup:)
leo_finops: Cushion provisioned and alerts active. Added note to account: "temporary safety net until Jan 05".
runbook-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 24h (6290003356).
maria_cs: Thanks all. If mitigation holds, we'll remove the renewal flag and include the playbook in the QBR packet.
